description: This file defines a mixin for generating Bootstrap grid classes dynamically based on provided parameters such as grid columns, gutter width, and breakpoints. It includes logic for creating classes for different column widths, auto-width columns, order classes, and offset classes, tailored for responsive design across breakpoints.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: A mixin that generates grid column classes based on the number of columns, gutter width, and breakpoints, enabling responsive grid layouts in Bootstrap.
